title: Strategic Partnerships & Influencer Lead - KSA
description:
We are looking for a Strategic Partnerships & Influencer Lead to build and lead moomoo's partnership and creator growth strategy in Saudi Arabia.
You will identify the partners, creators and communities that influence Saudi investors, build strong local relationships, structure commercially effective collaborations, and turn them into measurable business growth.
As an early member of the Saudi team, you will have significant ownership in shaping moomoo's local influencer and partnership strategy, while building and leading the team as the business scales.

1. Build Local Influencer & Partnership Strategy
Map the Saudi influencer, financial, media and business ecosystem and identify high-potential opportunities
Develop local partnership strategies that drive brand awareness, customer acquisition, AUM and revenue
Identify new growth opportunities based on local market insights

2. Own Strategic Partnerships
Source and build relationships with financial institutions, media, fintechs, consumer platforms, major brands and other strategic partners
Own the full partnership cycle from outreach and negotiation to launch and performance review
Develop creative cooperation models including co-marketing, education, referral programs, events, sponsorships and integrated campaigns

3. Build and Scale the Influencer Network
Identify and build relationships with leading finance, investing, business and relevant mainstream creators
Develop a strong influencer portfolio across different audience segments and content formats
Negotiate sustainable long-term, performance-based or exclusive cooperation models
Work with creators to develop content that aligns with both audience needs and business objectives

4. Drive Commercial Results
Own the commercial performance of influencer and partnership channels
Evaluate opportunities based on CAC, customer quality, AUM, trading activity, revenue and strategic value
Track performance, optimize partnerships and prioritize opportunities with the strongest business impact

5. Build Local Market Intelligence
Develop a strong understanding of how Saudi investors discover, evaluate and trust financial platforms
Build relationships across the local financial and business ecosystem
Monitor competitors, creators, platforms and emerging opportunities, and translate insights into local growth strategies

6. Lead Cross-functional Execution
Work closely with Marketing, Operations, Product, Compliance, Legal, Brand and Data teams to move opportunities from idea to execution
Coordinate internal resources, timelines and requirements for partnership launches
Ensure influencer and partnership activities meet local regulatory and internal requirements

7. Build & Lead the Team
Build and lead the Saudi Partnerships & influencer team as the market scales
Set team priorities, targets and execution standards, and ensure strong delivery against business goals
Coach and develop team members across prospecting, relationship management, negotiation and commercial execution
Establish scalable processes and local playbooks for sourcing, evaluating and managing partnerships and influencers
Build a high-ownership, commercially driven team culture and contribute to moomoo's broader Saudi growth strategy

Requirements

5+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, influencer/KOL partnerships, fintech, financial services, technology or media
Proven ability to source, negotiate and close meaningful commercial partnerships
Proven experience leading, coaching or developing BD, Partnership or KOL teams, with the ability to drive both individual and team performance
Strong understanding of the Saudi business, creator, media and digital ecosystem
Excellent relationship-building and communication skills with creators, founders and senior decision-makers
Strong commercial judgement and analytical ability, including understanding of CAC, AUM, revenue and ROI
Able to work from strategy through hands-on execution in a fast-moving, early-stage market
Strong cross-functional coordination and project-management skills
Fluent English required; Arabic and deep Saudi market knowledge strongly preferred
Experience in brokerage, investing, fintech or financial services is highly preferred

title: Brand Manager / Senior Brand Manager - Oncology & Hematology, KSA
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Job Summary

The role will be responsible for leading on uncovering customer (Health Care Professionals) insights, using strategic market data and analysis to support the development of the brand/molecule strategy. They will be responsible for supporting the life cycle planning (strategic and marketing), messaging development, implementation and execution of tactical plans, integrating cross functional partners and relationship management (internal and external) for successful marketing solutions in alignment with global and affiliate strategy. The role will focus on the Hematology portfolio, mainly in Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) and Mantle Cell Lymphoma (MCL).

Main Accountability/responsibility

Analysis

External market analysis/monitoring:

Review marketplace data and make recommendations from brand/molecule implications and actions.
Follow-up on research in partnership with market researchers/agency as needed to investigate implications and draw conclusions.
Communicate information about the market and insights to support with brand strategy.
Good market understanding of healthcare environment, current and future competitor actions
Good understanding of the CLL and MCL treatment landscape and competitors in KSA
Identification of key customer insights for brand in partnership with market research and agency partners. Develop a deep understanding of the customer target.

Internal Analysis

Contribute to the marketing plan by utilizing and building upon knowledge of brand history, heritage and evolution
Uses analysis to understand customer insights, identify Moments of truth (MOTs), use SWOT analysis to identify opportunities and issues.

Planning

Participates in and contributes to strategy development by actively participating and listening to insight generation activities across key players/ cross- functional experts and identifying opportunities/issues.
Develops a strategic plan under guidance
Participate in brand planning process and meetings
Identifies gaps between strategy and clinical/publication/product development plans that affect the life-cycle of the brand/molecule

Marketing Planning

Uses knowledge of the elements of the marketing mix, other marketing understanding tools, customer journey and ‘moments of truth’ to develop local marketing plans with clear objectives.
Identifies and applies the ‘Launch readiness framework’ to prepare for launch success in line with local market needs.
Plans brand activities in line with local processes and policies to ensure positive customer experience
Removes barriers that will prohibit Lilly KSA from delivering a positive customer experience
Identifies the pre-market conditioning activities that may be necessary to commercialize a molecule.
Works with Market Access on hospital formulary listings and tenders
Develops a commercialization plan with guidance
Uses working knowledge of standard pharmaceutical promotional practices to gain insight into short-term and future trends
Ensures brand tactics and insights are data driven
Identifies insights for brand partnership with Lilly Market Research (LMR)

Implementation and execution of brand strategy

Ability to update and reflect market strategy to reflect emerging/ changing trends
Identifies and implements MCE brand solutions in collaboration with Digital Marketing Manager
Recommends specific marketing tactics based on promotional mix, interpretation of published medical data etc.
Ability to test, monitor, evaluate marketing tactics and adjusts marketing plans accordingly
Uses appropriate project management tools to oversee plans and ensure that key milestones are met against specified timelines
Influence decision making cross-functionally, particularly as it pertains to developing insights based marketing strategies to improve patient outcomes. Comfortable with discussion/presentation to Management/leadership
Manages vendors and groups involved with tactical development and implementation
Creates internal communication plans with tailored messaging for key stakeholders
Utilizes data and analytics to track key execution measures and inform key internal stakeholders
Actively collaborates and close liaison with field based employees to understand customer needs and to execute tactical plans accordingly
Reviews production stocking and inventory process indicators to meet sales forecasts
Ensure risk management through compliance with all marketing guidelines, good promotional practices, privacy policies, and other policies and procedures.
Ensures Financial Management through tracking and managing budget for brand tactics including reconciliation. Where necessary make recommendations for financial trade-offs as needed.
Embrace new corporate/regional/affiliate strategic directions and new initiatives such as selling models and multichannel customer engagement where appropriate

External Relationship Management

Implements initiatives with key stakeholders that are important in supporting the brand strategy
Develop relationships with key Thought-Leaders (hematologists and hemato-oncologists), patient support groups and other healthcare organizations in related therapeutic areas to understand partnerships, environment shaping and alignment with Lilly objectives
Effectively manage agency relationships to support brand strategy and tactics

Internal Relationship Management

Partner closely with functions that are integral to the brand’s/molecule's success (e.g., sales, medical, corporate affairs and PAM) on a local, regional and global level
Participates in and contributes to cross-regional initiatives related to the brand strategy
Actively seeks feedback

Measurement

Monitors & evaluates marketing tactics and adjusting plans accordingly
Interprets results, communicates issues/risks, and identifies opportunities for improvement
Regularly monitors progress in metrics in partnership with management and support functions
Makes recommendations to management based on the interpretation of results and brand/market knowledge
Ability to answer key management/leadership questions

Professional Development

Keep up to date on trainings for professional development
Ensure myPM objectives are completed in line with company process
Understanding and adherence to all company policies and procedures

Educational Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Pharmacy or similar related field

Core

Knowledge and Experience

Minimum 3 years of experience in Pharmaceutical Sales, Key Account Management and/or Marketing
Experience of condensing complex issues into simple solutions

Desirable

Prior experience in marketing (Project work in brand management or digital marketing e.g. STA, marketing champion, Customer Plan work)
Prior experience in Oncology and/or Hematology (CLL or lymphoma is a plus)
Experience in specialty or hospital-based products

Skills

Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
Strong interpersonal and communication skills
Ability to work with strict deadlines and under pressure
Strong command of Microsoft Excel & PowerPoint
Excellent command of English and Arabic language
High learning agility and willingness to learn new skills
Ability to work effectively and deliver results within complex, changing environment
Enthusiastic, ability to energize and motivate others

Other Role Requirements

Will require domestic travel, and may require international travel
May require evening/weekend work
Must be legally allowed to work in KSA

title: Business Development Manager - KSA
description:
Join BIC World, a community of brands dedicated to creating ingeniously simple and joyful products that have been part of hearts and homes for over 75 years. We are committed to growing our iconic and innovative brands by reimagining everyday essentials in new, sustainable, and responsible ways.

Our culture encourages a "roll up your sleeves and get the job done" mindset, ensuring self-starters, problem solvers, and innovative thinkers can truly thrive. At BIC World, you are empowered to take ownership of your career and use your unique perspective to make a meaningful, global impact on our mission.

Job Summary

The Business Development Manager drives the growth and expansion of our product categories, Shavers, Ligthers & Stationery in the KSA market. The BDM role involves developing and executing strategic business plans, managing distributor relationships, to achieve sales targets and increase market share. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of the KSA market. The primary objective is to enhance net sales and profitability with a value-ahead volume mindset while ensuring compliance with company policies and local regulations.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning and Market Analysis:

Develop and implement comprehensive business development strategies to achieve sales targets and market share growth.
Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive landscape in KSA.
Set achievable goals and KPIs for market share, sales growth, and profitability.

Distributor Management

Identify, evaluate, and onboard new distributors to expand market coverage.
Establish and maintain strong relationships with existing distributors, ensuring alignment with company goals and strategies.
Conduct regular performance reviews with distributors, providing feedback and support to optimize their performance.
Negotiate contracts, pricing, and terms of trade with distributors to maximize profitability and market penetration.

Sales And Marketing Execution

Develop and execute sales and marketing plans with distributors to drive Physical and Mental Availability.
Ensure distributors have the tools, training, and support to promote and sell products effectively.
Monitor and analyze sales data to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions.

Financial Management

Prepare and manage budgets for the business development function, ensuring efficient allocation of resources.
Monitor financial performance, including sales, expenses, and profitability, and implement measures to achieve financial targets.
Work closely with the finance team to ensure accurate forecasting, reporting, and financial analysis.

Compliance And Risk Management

Ensure all business activities comply with relevant laws, regulations, and company policies.
Identify and mitigate risks associated with distributor management and market operations.
Stay updated on regulatory changes and market developments that may impact the business.

Reporting And Communication

Provide regular reports to senior management on market performance, business development activities, and strategic initiatives.
Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders, including marketing, finance, and supply chain teams, to ensure alignment and support for business development efforts.
Serve as the primary point of contact between the company and distributors, ensuring effective communication and collaboration

Key Performance Indicators

Sales Growth: Increase sales revenue for the three categories year over year.
Market Share: Increase the market share for all product categories in KSA.
Profitability: Improve profit margins and profitability through effective cost management and pricing strategies.
Distributor Performance: Measure and improve distributor performance through sales volume, market coverage, and adherence to agreed terms.
Customer Satisfaction: Ensure high customer satisfaction and retention through quality products and distributor service.
New Distributor Acquisition: Successfully onboard and manage new distributors to expand market presence.
Inventory Turnover: Optimize inventory turnover rates for efficient supply chain management.
Budget Adherence: Maintain strict adherence to budgetary guidelines and achieve financial targets.
Promotional Effectiveness: Measure the success of marketing and promotional campaigns in driving sales and brand awareness.
Team Performance: Monitor and enhance the performance of the commercial direct report, ensuring they effectively meet their individual and team objectives.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, or a related field.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in business development, sales, or a related field.
Experience in the FMCG/Consumer goods or related industry
Business-level proficiency in English and Arabic
Strong understanding of KSA market and business practices.
Proven track record in business development and distributor management.
Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Strategic thinking and analytical abilities.
Leadership and team management experience.
Financial acumen and budget management skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
On-line Commerce know-how to effectively leverage digital platforms and e-commerce channels in FMCG business development strategies.

What does BIC Offer?

Work for an international FMCG leader with Iconic brands
A great team of highly motivated and enthusiastic people
Opportunities for growth within a global organization,

title: Senior Manager - Strategy and Governance
description:
We are looking for a Senior Manager - Strategy & Governance to support the development, governance, and execution of strategic priorities across the Marketing division.

The role will work closely with Marketing leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to translate strategic direction into clear priorities, initiatives, governance frameworks, and measurable outcomes. The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening strategic planning, performance management, decision-making, and accountability across Marketing.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategy & Strategic Planning

Lead the development and refinement of Marketing's strategic priorities, objectives, and multi-year plans
Translate strategic objectives into actionable initiatives, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes
Ensure alignment between Marketing priorities, corporate strategy, and wider organizational objectives
Support leadership in evaluating strategic priorities, opportunities, trade-offs, and key business decisions
Lead strategic assessments, benchmarking, and analysis to support future planning and decision-making
Support the development and evaluation of strategic initiatives and business cases

Strategy Governance

Develop and maintain governance frameworks that support effective strategy execution across Marketing
Establish clear planning cycles, decision-making forums, accountability mechanisms, and reporting structures
Define governance standards and ensure consistency across strategic planning and reporting activities
Facilitate governance forums and leadership reviews, ensuring decisions, actions, and accountabilities are clearly documented and followed through
Monitor adherence to agreed governance processes and identify opportunities to strengthen ways of working
Ensure strategic decisions and priorities are translated into clear ownership and execution requirements

Performance Management & Strategy Execution

Establish and oversee performance management frameworks, including KPIs, OKRs, scorecards, and strategic performance measures
Monitor progress against Marketing strategic objectives and key initiatives
Develop executive dashboards and performance reports that provide clear visibility of progress, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring intervention
Lead periodic performance reviews and recommend corrective actions where required
Ensure effective cascading of strategic objectives across Marketing functions and teams
Track execution of strategic initiatives and ensure alignment with agreed outcomes and timelines

Executive & Stakeholder Engagement

Act as a strategic partner to Marketing leadership on strategy, governance, performance, and execution matters
Partner with Marketing functions and relevant corporate teams to drive alignment on strategic priorities
Prepare high-quality executive presentations, strategic recommendations, and performance updates
Facilitate strategic discussions and working sessions with senior stakeholders
Build strong cross-functional relationships to support effective strategy execution and timely decision-making

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to enhance Marketing's strategic planning, governance, and performance management practices
Introduce frameworks, methodologies, templates, and tools that improve planning and execution effectiveness
Promote greater accountability, transparency, and data-driven decision-making across Marketing
Support capability building and adoption of strategy and governance best practices across the function

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Strategy, Marketing, Economics, Finance, Management, or a related discipline. MBA or relevant master's degree is preferred
7+ years of experience in strategy, strategic planning, governance, performance management, management consulting, transformation, or a related discipline
Demonstrated experience developing and implementing strategies, strategic plans, governance frameworks, and performance management frameworks
Strong experience in strategy execution, KPI/OKR management, executive reporting, and business planning
Proven ability to translate complex strategic priorities into practical plans and measurable initiatives
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capabilities
Excellent executive communication, presentation, and storytelling skills
Strong stakeholder management and influencing capabilities, with experience working with senior leadership

Benefits

Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

title: Sr. Manager
description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

This role is part of the KBO and EKQ Product CVP team, which supports Visa to offer a strong consumer value proposition in the market.

The role holder will work closely with the regional and CEMEA Products Leaders as well as other functions including Country management, Marketing, Finance etc. A key deliverable is to ensure a competitive product CVP through internal capabilities and external partnerships, to improve Visa’s market share and top of wallet position.

In specific, the role will support the CVP team to:

Manage existing product benefit providers with a view on improving customer proposition and balanced with optimizing return on Visa investment
Launch New product - includes expanding coverage of existing products to new markets as well as creating new variants based on regional requirements
Explore continuous improvement opportunities in the value proposition including customer benefits, services and overall user experience

Responsibilities

Be a problem solver and trusted advisor to the Head of CVP for KBO and EKQ
Project manage multiple CVP initiatives including product launches and enhancements and optimizations - covering business case preparation, system set up, pricing, communication etc.
Support in KBO and EKQ product strategy development through a combination of consumer research, Visa data analysis, tracking usage of existing benefits
Support in budget management including tracking of program performance and sharing forecasts with finance as per budget cycles
Develop CVP addressing new and evolving consumer needs and emerging segments.
Develop monetized benefit ecosystems, build strong business cases, and deliver measurable revenue impact
Co-create differentiated propositions with issuing banks, acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders
Develop compelling narratives, sales toolkits, and activation strategies to drive adoption
Partner with internal stakeholders such as the CEMEA CVP Hub, Interchange, Pricing, Marketing, Research, Data science, Merchant and Country teams.
Work with external partners including existing benefit providers and continuously evaluate new options
Support initiatives such as benefits resell, enabling clients to differentiate their proposition in the market
Use data, consumer insights, and market trends to continuously refine and enhance propositions

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Qualifications

10 to 15 years’ experience in financial and fintech industries
Existing experience of working for GCC market and familiarity with local payments ecosystem and regulations
Strong track record in Product development / consumer propositions / value-added services / card benefits
Expertise in product strategy & go-to-market execution, revenue ownership and commercial structuring, vendor sourcing, negotiation, and partnerships & cross-functional leadership across complex organizations
Strong understanding of the clients’ business and how it aligns with Visa’s strategy
Project management skills and strong execution capability to deliver against tight deadlines
Strategic thinking, strong analytical skills and financial acumen
Self-directed and motivated with the ability to operate in a fast paced and constantly changing work environment
Digitally curious, follows industry trends and can utilize this exposure to develop Visa’s products, customer experience and digital offerings
Solid interpersonal skills, ability to effectively work and collaborate across the organization

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Senior Manager SA&I
description:
Job Description

Due to the company's new strategy, exciting opportunity has been created whereby we are looking to add a Senior Manager for our Strategic Analytics and Insights team based in Riyadh.

The senior manager will help with the delivery of client centric solutions in the area of consumer insight and marketing effectiveness solutions. The purpose of this role is to accelerate top line and deliver profitable growth by delivering against opportunities in client-facing work and helping our clients achieve higher ROI with key business questions expertise.

Responsibilities :

Develop, implement, coordinate, and manage ad hoc, usually survey-based research services projects through understanding clients’ business needs and developing research frameworks and proposals accordingly
Preparing proposals that tackle that clients’ business objectives
Developing and managing client relationships
Briefing and training field staff
Designing questionnaire, interview / discussion guide
Analyzing data and information
Developing conclusion and solid recommendation
Controlling costs/budgeting
Act as main link resource to client. Develop and maintain close relationship and communication with client decision makers
Gather and accumulate useful field data, summarize and analyze secondary data

Qualifications

At least 8 years of experience in research-related field preferably with retail, marketing sciences or CRM emphasis
Experience in Custom / adhoc survey based research especially in the area of consumer insight or brand-tracking solutions would be preferred. Experience in digital analytics would be a further plus
Analytical with excellent writing, presentation and communication skills in English
Strong organizational and project, and excellent attention to detail, with an ability to deliver results accurately and on time

They love solving problems, getting hands-on, experimenting, measuring, and using automation to make daily life easier.

Data-driven mindset, using insights to refine strategies and improve performance.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

The role of a Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager at Canonical

Ubuntu is the fastest growing enterprise Linux, the leading platform for public cloud computing, and the engineer's favorite way to drive the future.

Our goal is to help the enterprise embrace open source from end to end, across every class of compute and every class of application, starting with the linux kernel itself, to infrastructure solutions like OpenStack and Kubernetes, all the way up to data, security, analytics and serverless capabilities.

The Silicon Alliances Team works with the leading semiconductor companies to combine open source adoption with innovative optimizations to get the most from each new chip. With our semiconductor partners, we develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, formulate go-to-market plans and conceptualize new business models, enabling differentiated hardware and robust product life-cycle support while still anchored to best-in-class Ubuntu. The end goal is a frictionless experience to deploy, maintain, and develop on any hardware from cloud to edge.

The successful candidate is someone who is passionate about both hardware and software technology with interest to grow into business development. We are hiring for positions across early career to senior roles, with scope ranging from small exploratory partnerships to managing our largest and most strategic partnerships.

If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you.

Location: We are hiring for remote roles in Americas. We will also consider applicants in EMEA who can accommodate a shifted schedule to support Silicon partners in Americas. Global travel to sprints, events, and partner meetings is part of the role.

What your day will look like

Represent Canonical, its solutions and software to partners.
Develop a deep understanding of silicon partner strategies, technologies and roadmaps and identify overlap with Canonical’s current and future products.
Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing and sales teams to facilitate new business, leading definition of joint products, solutions and complex programs relying heavily on your communicating and influencing skills.
Ensure that robust project plans are created, tracked, and executed.
Develop joint Go To Market strategy and campaigns with silicon partners, manage market messaging, collateral and launch plans across products.
Negotiate successful contracts.

What we are looking for in you

B.A / B.S / B.E degree in science, technology and/or engineering.
Fundamental understanding of the semiconductor industry and ecosystem.
Experience in software and system architecture is preferred.
Customer-facing experience in business development, technology strategy or similar functions.
Excellent communication skills; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.
Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels
Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

Experience with open source software and open source business models is preferred.
Team leadership or program management experience.

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Parental Leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Account Manager (Growth) - Global Business Solutions- Arabic speaking - Riyadh - GBS
description:
Responsibilities
TikTok's Global Business Solutions (GBS) regional sales and advertising teams drive revenue growth by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding clients, and running campaigns that deliver measurable results.

Client needs, market trends, and performance expectations shift constantly, and differently in every market. We build strategy accordingly, turning those moving pieces into advertising solutions that work and client partnerships that last.

You will help businesses grow on a global platform, working on the campaigns and relationships that turn advertisers into long-term partners.

This role is nationalized in accordance with the requirements of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development and is only available to Saudi national citizens and any person who qualifies for equivalent status for Saudization purposes.

TikTok's Growth team helps businesses and brands unlock growth by connecting with their audiences through TikTok. Our team combines commercial expertise with a customer-centric mindset to help advertisers achieve their marketing goals and scale their businesses.

As an Account Manager (Growth), you will manage and grow a diverse portfolio of advertisers across MENA, with a focus on revenue growth, client success and product adoption. You will build trusted relationships with clients, identify opportunities to scale their investment and provide strategic guidance to help them achieve their business objectives on TikTok.

Success in this position requires strong sales and account management skills, digital advertising expertise, analytical thinking and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This keeps the core intent of the original role while making the commercial ownership clearer.

Responsibilities:
- Own and grow a portfolio of SMB advertisers across the Middle East, driving revenue growth and long-term client success.
- Build trusted relationships with advertisers, identifying opportunities to increase investment and scale their business on TikTok.
- Develop account strategies based on client objectives, performance, seasonality and market opportunities.
- Drive adoption of TikTok's advertising products, measurement solutions and best practices.
- Identify, reactivate and develop high-potential advertisers across the portfolio.
- Partner cross-functionally with Product, Finance, Marketing, Operations and other teams to solve client challenges and unlock growth.
- Maintain strong sales discipline across pipeline management, forecasting, client engagement and opportunity planning.
- Share market and client insights to help shape TikTok's SMB strategy across the region.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Due to needs of the KSA market and clients, this role will require Arabic language proficiency alongside English.
- Experience in sales, account management, digital advertising, paid media and/or marketing.
- Proven ability to manage and grow a portfolio of advertisers against commercial targets.
- Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills.
- Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.
- Strong team player with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Strong knowledge of social media, digital and mobile advertising.
- Knowledge of self-service, auction and biddable digital advertising.
- Experience managing and growing SMB advertisers.
- Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
- Experience using data and insights to identify growth opportunities and develop client strategies.
- Passion for TikTok and helping businesses grow through the platform.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

title: Creative Marketing Specialist
description:

Serva is a Saudi technology company building solutions that help businesses better understand their customers, assess risk, and make informed decisions. We combine data, technology, and AI to simplify complex processes and help businesses operate with greater confidence. Our initial focus includes the mobility and vehicle rental sector, with a broader vision across industries.

For more information, visit www.serva.sa.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a creative B2B marketer who can turn complex products and ideas into clear messages, engaging content, and campaigns that connect with business audiences.

You’ll work closely with our Product and Sales teams to build Serva’s presence, communicate the value of our solutions, and support business growth. You’ll also use AI tools throughout the creative process, from research and ideation to content production, campaign execution, and performance analysis.

Job Title: Creative Marketing Specialist – B2B
Location: Riyadh
Type: Full-Time

Key Responsibilities
Develop creative marketing concepts and campaigns that communicate Serva’s products and value to business audiences.
Research target markets, customer needs, decision-makers, and competitors to identify relevant marketing opportunities.
Create clear and engaging Arabic and English content for Social Media, websites, email campaigns, advertisements, and other channels.
Translate technical concepts, into content that is easy for business customers to understand.
Create and edit visual content, including social media assets, presentations, short videos, and product explainers, using design and AI tools.
Use AI to explore ideas, develop content variations, repurpose materials across channels, and improve production efficiency.
Plan and execute B2B campaigns, including landing pages and calls to action that support customer acquisition and demo requests.
Work with the Sales team to develop pitch decks, product sheets, customer stories, and other sales materials.
Support product launches and maintain consistent messaging across Serva’s channels and customer touchpoints.
Track content and campaign performance, analyze results, and recommend improvements based on data.
Build simple AI-powered workflows and automations to streamline repetitive marketing activities.
Review AI-generated content for accuracy, brand consistency, and appropriate handling of company and customer information.

Requirements
Experience in creative marketing or content marketing, preferably in a B2B technology or SaaS company.
Strong Arabic and English writing skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics.
Hands-on experience using AI tools for research, content creation, visual production, or marketing workflows.
Ability to create and edit marketing visuals and short-form videos using relevant tools.
Understanding of B2B customer journeys and how marketing supports sales.
Experience planning campaigns and measuring their performance using analytics or CRM tools.
Strong creative thinking, attention to detail, and ability to manage work from idea to execution.
A portfolio showing relevant work and your personal contribution.

Nice to Have
Experience marketing AI, data, fintech, or enterprise software products.
Familiarity with landing-page builders, marketing automation, and no-code tools.
Experience developing product marketing materials, customer stories, or sales enablement content.
Knowledge of the mobility, vehicle rental, or transportation sectors.
Experience running and optimizing paid B2B campaigns.
